collection_timeframes.timeframe_details: Data collection is described as retrospective and is carried out over the NIH award period, which runs from 2022-09-01 to 2026-11-30. As of August 2025 the assembled dataset covered 14 different hospitals.
collection_timeframes.source_caveats: The dates given are the NIH project period for award OT2OD032701, not the clinical period the admissions are drawn from. Because extraction is retrospective, the admissions almost certainly predate the award, and the bundle does not state the temporal coverage of the clinical data.
